name: Cohere
summary: The embedding and reranking vendor most of RAG stacks quietly depend on, plus command models for enterprise tasks.
description:
Cohere's most-used capability is unglamorous and load-bearing: embeddings that behave across languages and domains, and a reranker that fixes retrieval after the fact. Add grounded generation with citations and a deploy story that includes single-tenant and local options, and it becomes the vendor you pick when retrieval quality and data handling both matter.

Embedding models are a switching cost — re-indexing a corpus is not free — so compare on recall over your documents, not on a public leaderboard. And a reranker is a second bill per query, which changes the arithmetic of a high-traffic search feature.
